svg.title: Guardrails: check the prompt, the tool calls and the output
svg.desc: Guardrails run your guard functions at the edges of a run. InputGuardrail checks the prompt in wrap_model_request before the model sees it. ToolGuardrail checks tool arguments in before_tool_execute and tool results in after_tool_execute. OutputGuardrail checks the final output in after_output_process before the caller gets it. A table shows what allow, block, replace, retry and approve do at each point.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
